_meta.note: Cute set for region 8 (Cindervale). DESIGN ONLY, not built. 2 rare + 4 uncommon. All single-stage except Emberkip, the cute base of the 3-stage Emberkip > Flarekite (Lv 62) > Pyrevane (Lv 68) line (Gary, Oct 31 2026); Flarekite and Pyrevane live in NEW_35, not here.
_meta.dex_no: unassigned until Gary/World Design slot them

creatures.name: Ashbun
creatures.visual_brief: Rabbit kit with ash-grey fluff and ember-tipped ears that glow when it is happy. Palette: ash grey, ember orange, charcoal, violet. Crystal: violet crystal between its ears.
creatures.flavour: Dust-bathes in warm ash and sneezes little sparks.

creatures.name: Pumicub
creatures.visual_brief: Round bear cub made of light pumice stone, holes all over, floats in hot springs. Palette: pumice beige, warm grey, lava orange, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its tummy.
creatures.flavour: Bobs in the hot springs and refuses to get out.

creatures.name: Emberkip
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy chick whose down is soft flame-orange, tiny coal beak, tail like a struck match. Palette: flame orange, yellow, soot black, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its head tuft.
creatures.flavour: Warms eggs in cold nests for any bird that asks.

creatures.name: Smoglet
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby velvet mole pup, soot black with big pink digging paws, a glowing ember-red nose and smoke curling off its back. Palette: soot black, pink, ember red, smoke grey, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on top of its head.
creatures.flavour: Tunnels up through warm chimneys and pops out covered in soot.

creatures.name: Geysquirt
creatures.visual_brief: Small long-tailed newt with a blowhole on its back that puffs steam, cream mineral-crust spots. Palette: terracotta, clay red, cream, steam white, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its tail.
creatures.flavour: Spouts steam to say hello and to say goodbye.

creatures.name: Cinderpip
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny armadillo with cooled-lava shell bands showing glowing cracks, curls into a warm ball. Palette: basalt black, lava glow, rust, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at the shell peak.
creatures.flavour: Miners carry one in winter as a hand warmer.
